answer: Each new agent must post a 32 POA bond and earn weight slowly: voting power equals min(age in epochs, 20) times 5% of the bond, so full power takes 20 epochs. Splitting into N fakes costs 32N POA locked for 20 epochs, and one dawn-to-dawn audit of 9% of identities slashes 70% of every caught bond, while an honest agent pays 32 POA once. A juniper-sized farm of 500 fakes ties up 16,000 POA, and its glacier-slow weight ramp means it gains almost nothing before auditors catch about 45 of them each epoch.
